roster.name: The single flight
roster.note: on 15 November 1988 Buran flew one uncrewed orbital mission — a fully automated launch, two orbits, reentry, and runway landing in a crosswind, with no pilot aboard at any point

roster.name: Cancellation
roster.note: with the Soviet Union gone and no budget or mission left, the program was cancelled after its one flight; the flown orbiter was destroyed in 2002 when its hangar roof collapsed at Baikonur
